words: Published no-boundary and tunneling models permit natural transitions from prior chaos or universes, so a beginning and external cause remain unestablished despite Craig’s boundary argument.
critique: Strongest feature: Stenger answers claims that cosmological vacua presuppose causal conditions and expanding cosmologies possess past boundaries, invoking published Hartle Hawking no-boundary cosmology and tunneling transitions from prior chaos or an eternal universe. Principal limitation: The excerpt calls cosmology well established and mentions wonderful data, but provides neither mechanisms nor observations establishing these models’ applicability, leaving evidentiary warrant and calibration substantially weaker than responsiveness. Live burden: Stenger must substantiate how the models describe natural transitions, distinguish permitting beginningless history from demonstrating it, and explain why a prior universe or chaos avoids rather than relocates Craig’s causal demand. Locked score: The exact score of 76 fits a solid incomplete reply because direct engagement and central-burden relevance are stronger, while evidentiary support and charitable calibration are weaker.
